ADHD care, by place and by profession.

Short guides to ADHD care in Australia. Each covers one common search, lists the ADHDme clinicians who can help, and gives the cost before you book.

By place

  • ADHD doctor Gold Coast: who to see and costsADHD care on the Gold Coast: psychologists and an exercise physiologist in Bundall, plus a GP assessment by phone for $498 in total.
  • ADHD GP Brisbane: diagnosis, medication, costsQueensland GPs can now diagnose adult ADHD and prescribe. Who sees Brisbane patients in the ADHDme network, and a GP assessment by phone for $498.
  • ADHD assessment Queensland: three routes, costsHow ADHD assessment works in Queensland since the December 2025 reform: GP, psychologist or psychiatrist. No referral needed for a GP or psychologist.
  • ADHD assessment Sydney: GP, $498, no referralTwo GPs assess and diagnose ADHD in Beecroft, Double Bay and Hornsby. $498 across two consultations, no referral needed, with phone and telehealth options.
  • ADHD assessment online: what telehealth can doGet assessed for ADHD by phone or telehealth anywhere in Australia, with no referral. Which parts can be done remotely and which need a clinic visit.

By profession

  • ADHD exercise physiologist: benefits and fundingHow an exercise physiologist helps with ADHD, exercising safely on stimulants, and funding through a GP care plan. In person in Bundall on the Gold Coast.
  • ADHD psychologist: assessment, therapy, costsADHD psychologists assess, diagnose and provide therapy. With a GP’s Mental Health Treatment Plan, Medicare pays $101.55 or $149.05 a session.
  • ADHD psychologist Brisbane: assessment, telehealthEight ADHD psychologists at GOALS Psychology in Fortitude Valley and Neutral Minds in Ashgrove. ADHD and autism assessment, therapy and telehealth.
  • ADHD occupational therapist: help with daily lifeHow an occupational therapist helps with ADHD routines at home and school, and how OT is funded through the NDIS or a GP plan. Paediatric OT in Brisbane.
  • ADHD coaching in Australia: costs and JobAccessADHD coaching in Perth, Sutherland and online, what a session costs, and how JobAccess can fund it if you work at least eight hours a week.

After a diagnosis

  • ADHD treatment after diagnosis: what happens nextAfter an ADHD diagnosis: medication, therapy, OT and coaching. Who provides each, and how Medicare covers up to 10 psychology sessions a year.
